senses.sense_definition: de nieuwsgierigheid of belangstelling van iemand opwekken

examples.text: Het zal mij <w>benieuwen</w> wie deze wedstrijd gaat winnen.

target_lang_translations.it: Sono <w>curioso di vedere</w> chi vincerà questa partita.
target_lang_translations.en: I <w>wonder</w> who is going to win this match.

examples.text: Het <w>benieuwde</w> hem enorm wat er in dat geheimzinnige boek geschreven stond.

target_lang_translations.it: Lo <w>incuriosiva</w> enormemente cosa ci fosse scritto in quel libro misterioso.
target_lang_translations.en: He <w>was very curious</w> about what was written in that mysterious book.

target_lang_definitions.it: suscitare la curiosità o l'interesse di qualcuno
target_lang_definitions.en: to arouse someone's curiosity or interest; to make someone wonder

it.target_lang_sense_clarification: essere curioso di sapere (spesso nella forma 'het benieuwt mij')

en.target_lang_sense_clarification: to be curious to know (used impersonally, e.g. 'it makes me wonder')
